text: The Beck depression inventory (BDI) includes 21 items, all of which are assessed on a four-point
scale. One of the items is ‘irritation’, as shown below.
0 I am no more irritated by things than I ever was.
1 I am slightly more irritated now than usual.
I am quite annoyed or irritated a good deal of the time.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State two items from the BDI, other than ‘irritation’.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Explain the theory on which the BDI is based.

parts.label: (i)
parts.text: Suggest how the reliability of the BDI could be assessed.

parts.label: (ii)
parts.text: Suggest how the validity of the BDI could be assessed.

parts.text:

depression. You should include a conclusion in your answer.

text: ‘Cognitive explanations of schizophrenia ignore the effects of nature.’
To what extent do you agree with this statement? Use examples of research you have studied to
support your answer. [12]
